title: Console on a phone: reloading or opening a record-drawer link that also carries a related-record form (?recordId=…&form=new&formObject=…&formLink=…) lands on the record page with no form
body:
domain:ui#6 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUAXJEaRNwDiLuAvEZ

Follow-up of #32685 (PR #32748), found by its card thread while measuring the phone arm. Not in #32685's file surface; the PR does not change this behaviour.

Filing category: ① product defect (user-visible). reach: Console on a phone-width viewport (Playwright iPhone 13), `pnpm dev:stack --with-ui`, on the #32748 branch (`0ad90392`); the code path is unchanged on `main` (read, not run, on `main`).

## 维护者速读

在手机上打开（或刷新）一个「记录侧栏 + 新建关联记录表单」的链接，比如从桌面复制过来的分享链接，表单会闪一下（约半秒）就消失，最后只停在记录页，没有表单。原因是手机不画侧栏，而是把列表地址换成记录页地址，换的时候只保留了来源列表的信息，没有把 `form`、`formObject`、`formLink` 这几个参数带过去。

## What happens

1. On a phone-width viewport, open a list URL that names a drawer record and a related-record form: `…/<object>?recordId=<id>&form=new&formObject=<child>&formLink=<link>`.
2. The phone has no drawer: `ObjectView.tsx` (~:1416) renders the page column instead of `ObjectViewRecordOverlay`, and `objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` (~:424) answers the drawer link with `handleNavOverlayNavigate(drawerRecordId, undefined, undefined, true)`.
3. That handler (`objectViewRecordNavigation.ts` ~:225–253, read on `main`) navigates to `record/<id>` (or `../../record/<id>`) with no search string; the list's search goes only into `state.from` (minus `recordId`). `form`, `formObject` and `formLink` are dropped, so the form `AppContent` opened from the URL closes about half a second later.
4. Result: the record page, no form. Screenshot: `/mnt/project-files/issue-32685/phone-reload-redirects-to-record-page-en-iphone13.png`.

## Expected

The phone redirect keeps the record-form parameters (`form`, `formObject`, `formLink`, and any seeded-create parameters the form reads), so the form opens over the record page, as the same link does on a desktop over the drawer. A link with no form parameters behaves exactly as today (CONTROL).

Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/objectViewRecordNavigation.ts`). Triage decides the grade.

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue phone formObject` and `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue handleNavOverlayNavigate form` → 7 and 3 hits (QA run records; #16885 closed, form-view navigation; #25992 closed, the ObjectView split; #27524 closed), none on the dropped form parameters; nearest are #27058 (closed: the phone answers the drawer link with the record page) and #29074 (closed: the page's back goes to the list).

Related: #32685, PR #32748.
